data.narrative:
Project Omega, a Seed-stage nuclear energy company led by Stafford Sheehan, has raised $12M to date. The nuclear energy sector comprises 11 comparable companies: 3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $12M raised proxy, yielding a $30M implied valuation. This reflects the typical valuation step-up from Seed to Series A in the sector. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient depth in the narrow peer set—while 6 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three datapoints aligned with same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier valuation criteria, making a sector-wide median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, with a median of $30M. This estimate rests on a single quantitative method, introducing material uncertainty. The primary risks to this range are (1) the breadth of stage-progression multipliers across frontier tech, which can vary substantially by capital efficiency and technical risk, and (2) limited public market comparables in advanced nuclear, constraining external validation. Additional Series A term sheet activity or refined peer financials would strengthen conviction.
